name: Why is plan review coordination necessary for my project?
description: It ensures your project obtains necessary permits, complies with local regulations, and avoids costly delays or fines during construction.

mainEntity.name: Why is plan review coordination necessary for my project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Plan review coordination is necessary to obtain the required permits for your construction project. Without approved plans from all relevant departments, you cannot legally begin construction. Engaging in thorough coordination helps identify potential issues early, preventing costly delays, redesigns, or even fines during construction. For instance, projects in areas like Alameda or Berkeley often have specific historical preservation or environmental considerations that require careful navigation.
